Copy these 9 files from https://github.com/microsoft/detours into this folder:

    detours.h
    detver.h
    detours.cpp
    creatwth.cpp
    disasm.cpp
    disolx86.cpp
    disolx64.cpp
    image.cpp
    modules.cpp

The x86 DLL and Launcher builds use: detours.cpp creatwth.cpp disasm.cpp
    disolx86.cpp image.cpp modules.cpp   (disolx64.cpp is NOT compiled for x86)

The x64 Server build does not use Detours at all.
